suppress.notes: app.jar: Google Cloud Application Integration advisory. app.jar holds the Dumper's own classes. Dependency-Check derives the google:application_integration CPE from the words google and application in its package names (com.google.edwmigration.dumper.application); CVE-2025-0982 is in the JavaScript Task feature of the Google Cloud Application Integration service, which the Dumper does not contain. Moved here from known_cves.yml.

grpc-netty-shaded: netty advisories that do not affect the bundled netty 4.1.124. Dependency-Check identifies grpc-netty-shaded as netty with grpc's own version (1.76.1), so it matches every netty advisory with a range below 4.x. The jar bundles netty 4.1.124.Final (META-INF/io.grpc.netty.shaded.io.netty.versions.properties) with the modules buffer, common, transport, resolver, handler, handler-proxy, codec, codec-http, codec-http2, codec-socks and native epoll. Each advisory below was either fixed before 4.1.124 or is in a netty module that the jar does not bundle (codec-haproxy, codec-dns, resolver-dns, codec-stomp, codec-redis, codec-xml, codec-mqtt, handler-ssl-ocsp, codec-http3, transport-sctp), per the affected packages and ranges of the GitHub-reviewed advisory. The advisories that do affect 4.1.124 are not suppressed here; they are in known_cves.yml.

databricks-jdbc: netty advisories on the bundled netty-buffer and netty-common 4.2.15. databricks-jdbc bundles only netty-buffer and netty-common 4.2.15.Final (relocated to com.databricks.internal.io.netty). Dependency-Check matches the netty CPE, which covers every netty module; the advisories below are in other netty modules (handler, codec-*, transport-sctp, resolver-dns, handler-ssl-ocsp, codec-http3), per the GitHub-reviewed advisories, or (CVE-2026-62380, CVE-2026-89044) in codec-socks and codec-http per their descriptions.

Apache Arrow (arrow-memory-core and the copy in databricks-jdbc): C and C++ advisories. CVE-2026-25087 is in Apache Arrow C++ and CVE-2026-111497 in the Brotli C decoder. The dumper ships only the Java Arrow libraries.
grpc-java jars: gRPC-Go advisory. CVE-2026-33186 is in gRPC-Go (the grpc:grpc CPE covers every gRPC implementation). The dumper ships grpc-java.

hadoop-thirdparty jars: Hadoop advisories matched against the thirdparty version. hadoop-shaded-protobuf_3_25 and hadoop-shaded-guava are Hadoop's relocated copies of protobuf and guava, versioned 1.4.0. Dependency-Check names them with the apache:hadoop CPE and that version, so every Hadoop advisory with a range below 1.4.0 matches. Hadoop itself ships as hadoop-common 3.4.2 and friends, which are scanned under their own version.

OpenTelemetry Java jars: advisories for the Go, JavaScript, .NET and C++ implementations. The opentelemetry:opentelemetry CPE covers every OpenTelemetry implementation. The advisories below are for OpenTelemetry-Go, OpenTelemetry-Go Contrib, opentelemetry-js, OpenTelemetry .NET and OpenTelemetry C++, per their descriptions and the GitHub-reviewed advisories (no Maven package). The dumper ships only OpenTelemetry Java and Google's Java exporters.
jmespath-java: jmespath.php advisory. CVE-2026-54133 is in jmespath.php. The dumper ships the AWS SDK's Java implementation (com.amazonaws:jmespath-java).
protobuf-java: Python protobuf advisory. CVE-2026-0994 is in google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict() of the Python library.

oozie-client: Oozie web console advisory. CVE-2025-26796 is a cross-site scripting issue in the Oozie server web console (GitHub advisory: org.apache.oozie:oozie-core). The dumper ships only the client library, which has no web interface.

spring-core: Spring Framework advisories in modules the dumper does not ship. Dependency-Check maps the framework-wide spring_framework CPE onto spring-core. The dumper ships spring-core, spring-beans, spring-jdbc and spring-tx 5.3.39. Each advisory below is in another module (spring-webmvc, spring-webflux, spring-web, spring-websocket, spring-expression, spring-context, spring-context-support, spring-messaging, spring-jms), per the GitHub-reviewed advisory or, for advisories GitHub has not reviewed, per the description. The advisories that do affect the shipped modules (CVE-2025-41249, CVE-2026-41848, CVE-2026-59282) are in known_cves.yml.

Standalone netty jars: request smuggling advisory in netty-codec-http. CVE-2026-89044 (Transfer-Encoding validation, netty 4.1.133 to 4.1.137) is in the HTTP codec. Dependency-Check reports it on whichever standalone netty jar it groups the netty CPE under (netty-transport or netty-transport-native-epoll). The dumper does not ship netty-codec-http as a jar, and the rule does not apply to one; the only copy of the codec is the 4.1.124 one inside grpc-netty-shaded, which is outside the affected range.
